name: Cover 1 Hole with Linebacker A-Gap Mug
formation: Nickel 4-2-5 Single-Mug Front vs 11P Gun 3x1 Slant/Choice
coverage: Cover 1 Hole (Man-to-Man with Low-Hole MIKE Rat)
frontName: A-Gap Mug Front with Wide-9 Edges

summary.motive: Threaten A-gap pressure to force quick slant/in routes, then drop the mugged linebacker into the low hole to bracket underneath passes while the 4-man Wide-9 front collapses the pocket.
summary.whyItWorks: Offensive quarterbacks are coached to throw hot slants against A-gap pressure, throwing the football directly to the low-hole defender who baited the throw.
summary.failureMode: A double-move route (whip/pivot or slant-and-go) that breaks back outside away from the inside low-hole linebacker.

beats.title: A-Gap Mug Presentation Pre-Snap
beats.text: DeMeco Ryans lines up MIKE mugging the A-gap while corners press tight on the perimeter, presenting an aggressive 5-man pressure look in the red zone.

beats.title: MIKE Bails to Low Hole, 4-Man Rush Fires
beats.text: At the snap, MIKE drops into the 5-yard low hole ("Rat in the Hole") while the 4-man defensive line brings ferocious organic pressure led by 3T penetrating inside.

beats.title: Slot Slant Choked in Low-Hole Bracket
beats.text: The QB throws his hot slant to H against what he believed was man-pressure, only for MIKE to wall off the slant lane while NICKEL trails on the outside hip.

beats.title: Interior Penetration Finishes the Sack
beats.text: With the quick throw eliminated, 3T rips past the RG for an unblocked interior sack before the quarterback can scan to his secondary progressions.

relations.tell: MIKE mugs the A-gap pre-snap then immediately drops 5 yards into the low hole while corners press and safeties roll into single-high robber
